rows.label: tlk70000076_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Oh, haven't you already
left for Aletta?

rows.label: tlk70000076_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Could it be you want another mock
battle with me?

rows.label: tlk70000076_02_msg0003
rows.name:
What? If I insist, you'd fight me
again? No, no, I'm kidding!

rows.label: tlk70000076_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I already know your strength all too
well!

rows.label: tlk70000076_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Y'know, you lot aren't much
like the Drivers in Superbia.
You're different somehow.

rows.label: tlk70000076_02_msg0006
rows.name:
How should I put it...? You respect
your Blades as people... It's more
like an equal relationship...

rows.label: tlk70000076_02_msg0007
rows.name:
Watching you makes me think Iira's
idea of "coexistence between people
and Blades" may not be so bad.
